title: Linear OAuth App Manifest

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema document used by editors and tooling to validate this manifest.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the OAuth app manifest format. Must be 1.0.0.
schemaVersion.title: Schema Version

distribution.description: Allow this application to be installed by other workspaces. Defaults to private.
distribution.title: Public

display.description: Additional display metadata shown to users during authorization, installation, and settings.
display.title: Display

description.title: Description
examples: Allows a user to create Linear issues from within the Bug Reporter application.

iconUrl.description: Application icon shown during authorization and in settings. Use an image at least 256x256px.
iconUrl.title: Application icon

name.description: The person or company developing this application
name.title: Developer name

developer.description: Public information about the person or company responsible for the app.
developer.title: Developer

allOf.description: OAuth client name must not contain "Linear".
OAuth client name must not contain http:// or https://.

client_name.description: User visible name for your application. Must not contain "Linear" or URL text.
client_name.title: Application name

client_uri.description: Homepage or documentation for your application. Required for public applications.
client_uri.title: Developer URL

redirect_uris.description: All OAuth redirect URIs. Each URI must exactly match one used by the app.
redirect_uris.title: Redirect URIs

grant_types.description: OAuth grant capabilities the app may use. authorization_code is required. Support generating OAuth access tokens using the client_credentials grant type. See https://linear.app/developers/oauth-2-0-authentication#client-credentials-tokens. Defaults to authorization_code.
grant_types.title: Grant types

oauth.description: OAuth behavior Linear should register for the app.
oauth.title: OAuth

webhook.description: Webhook subscription configuration for the OAuth app.
webhook.title: Webhook

url.description: Absolute HTTPS URL that receives webhook events for this OAuth app.
url.title: Webhook URL

enabled.description: Webhooks allow you to receive HTTP push notifications on your specified URL. See https://linear.app/developers/webhooks. Defaults to true.
enabled.title: Webhooks

items.description: Webhook resource type to subscribe to.

resourceTypes.description: Whenever selected data types are created or updated
resourceTypes.title: Data change events

description: Manifest used to define a Linear OAuth app, including display metadata, developer information, OAuth configuration, and optional webhook subscriptions.

display.description: Allows a user to create Linear issues from within the Bug Reporter application.
